## `bans`

One ban per document. A ban matches a player by uuid or by ip; unbanning deletes the document.

Disagreements and constraints:

- `ban_id`: Must be a 32-bit int: the unique index on ban_id only covers {$type: 'int'}, so an int64 copy would escape it.
- `ip`: No IP has three shapes: the plugin omits the field (its codec skips nulls) and releases an IP with {$set: null}, the bot writes null, and both account merges remove it from the original of a copied ban with $unset. Every reader treats all three alike.
- `admin_discord_id`: The plugin writes "" for no moderator id, the bot writes null. The bot normalises both to None; the plugin passes the raw value on.
- `expire_date`: A permanent ban from the plugin has no expire_date (its codec skips nulls); one from the bot has expire_date: null. Every reader treats both as permanent.

## `counters`

Sequences and singletons, one document per _id. Every allocation is a findOneAndUpdate with {$inc: {seq: 1}} and upsert, so concurrent writers never hand out a number twice.

- **plugin**: [`V7__AssignBanIds.java`](../../plugins/xcore/src/main/java/org/xcore/plugin/database/migration/V7__AssignBanIds.java), [`BanDataRepository.java`](../../plugins/xcore/src/main/java/org/xcore/plugin/database/repository/BanDataRepository.java), [`MapDataRepository.java`](../../plugins/xcore/src/main/java/org/xcore/plugin/database/repository/MapDataRepository.java), [`PlayerDataRepository.java`](../../plugins/xcore/src/main/java/org/xcore/plugin/database/repository/PlayerDataRepository.java)
- **bot**: [`store.py`](../../services/discord-bot/src/xcore_discord_bot/cases/store.py), [`punishment_store.py`](../../services/discord-bot/src/xcore_discord_bot/punishment_store.py)

| Field | Type | Written by | Read by | Fallback when missing |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `_id` | "ban_id" \| "player_id" \| "case_number" \| "last_map_decay" | **plugin** `BanDataRepository.java`, `PlayerDataRepository.java`, `MapDataRepository.java`<br>**bot** `punishment_store.py`, `store.py` | **plugin** `BanDataRepository.java`, `PlayerDataRepository.java`, `MapDataRepository.java`<br>**bot** `punishment_store.py`, `store.py` |  |
| `seq` | integer | **plugin** `BanDataRepository.java`, `PlayerDataRepository.java`, `V7__AssignBanIds.java`<br>**bot** `punishment_store.py`, `store.py` | **plugin** `BanDataRepository.java`, `PlayerDataRepository.java`<br>**bot** `punishment_store.py`, `store.py` |  |
| `time` | int64 | **plugin** `MapDataRepository.java` | **plugin** `MapDataRepository.java` |  |

Disagreements and constraints:

- `banId`: Ban numbers are 32-bit: the highest both allocators can hand out is 2147483647. Past it the plugin has already advanced seq when Math.toIntExact throws, so every later allocation fails too, while the bot returns the out-of-range number and stores it as an int64 ban_id that the unique index does not cover.
- `playerId`: The plugin reads seq with Document.getInteger, so an int64 seq here would make every new player fail to save.

Disagreements and constraints:

- `case_number`: Nothing reads it back today: the case flows pass the number of the case they are working on.
- `admin_discord_id`: The plugin writes "" for no moderator id, the bot writes null.
- `expire_date`: The plugin's model allows a mute without expiry (Punishment.expireDate may be null, and its codec would then omit the field), but no command creates one today. The bot's MuteDoc requires a date, so such a mute would make find_mute raise.

## `players`

One document per Mindustry UUID. The plugin saves a player with {$set: <every field it models>} rather than replacing the document, so fields written by others or by older versions survive its saves. Those saves leave out every discord_* field: only the link operations and the account merges write them. Any field can be missing on a document an older plugin created.

| `is_visible` | boolean | **plugin** `ModelData.java` | **plugin** `ModelData.java` |  |
| `visible` | boolean | **plugin** `ModelData.java` |  |  |
| `version` | integer | **plugin** `ModelData.java` | **plugin** `ModelData.java` |  |
| `admin_confirmed` | boolean | **plugin** `V1__InitModernDatabase.java` |  |  |

Disagreements and constraints:

- `hexed_rank`: The bot's account merge recomputes the rank from hexed_points with its own copy of the thresholds (0, 3, 10, 20, 25, 30); the plugin's HexedRanks holds the original.
- `discord_linked_at`: The plugin writes an int64 kept monotonic through discord_link_generation; the bot's account merge writes a plain int (0 is stored as int32) and does not advance discord_link_generation. Every reader compares numerically, so the width is harmless.
- `created_model_time`: The website falls back to created_model_time when created_at is missing. No writer has used that name: before V1 the field was createdModelTime, and V1 renamed it to created_at.

## `player_totals`

No schema yet.

- **plugin**: [`V10__SeparateTowerDefenceAndRvsbStats.java`](../../plugins/xcore/src/main/java/org/xcore/plugin/database/migration/V10__SeparateTowerDefenceAndRvsbStats.java), [`PlayerTotalsStore.java`](../../plugins/xcore/src/main/java/org/xcore/plugin/service/stats/PlayerTotalsStore.java)
- **bot**: [`account_merge_store.py`](../../services/discord-bot/src/xcore_discord_bot/account_merge_store.py), [`game_stats.py`](../../services/discord-bot/src/xcore_discord_bot/game_stats.py)
- **web**: [`player-totals.ts`](../../web/src/lib/server/player-totals.ts), [`stats.ts`](../../web/src/lib/server/stats.ts)

- Materialized per-player stats, keyed by uuid. Every reader follows redirect_uuid after merges.
- The bot's account merge writes the same invalidation as the plugin (revision, rebuild.dirty, rebuild.queued_at, status, schema_version) but $inc's revision by an int32 1 where the plugin uses an int64.
- V10 stamps rules_version so a server still on the old jar does not claim these players; neither the plugin's invalidation nor the bot's merge sets rules_version on a new document, so those stay claimable by old jars.
- The plugin (PlayerTotalsView) and the bot check status before schema_version, the website the other way round: a pending document with an unknown schema_version is 'pending' in game and in Discord and an error on the site.
